Blush Studio — Bridal Makeup & Styling, Mumbai

Blush Studio is a Mumbai bridal makeup and styling house offering a team of
artists for the bride and her family, covering multiple events across a wedding.
They are known for a polished, camera-ready finish and for handling large bridal
parties without delays.

Their bridal package (two events for the bride) is ₹85,000, with family makeup
charged per person. Destination travel and stay are billed separately.

Contact: +91 98201 45567 · hello@blushstudio.example
Location: Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (164 reviews)

What couples say:
"Whole bridal party was ready on time — very well organized."
"Camera-ready finish that looked flawless in photos."
"Professional team that managed a hectic morning smoothly."

Blush Studio fields a multi-artist team, which is a real advantage for big
families needing several people ready simultaneously. They offer trial sessions
and coordinate with photographers on shoot timing.

That said, a pattern in recent reviews is worth flagging: for several 2023
weddings, brides reported that the senior artist they had specifically booked
(and seen at the trial) did not show up on the wedding day, with a junior team
member sent instead and no advance notice — in two cases the final look
reportedly differed noticeably from the trial. One client also alleged that an
additional "peak-date surcharge" was added to the bill on the morning of the
event, after the package price had already been agreed. The studio says it has
since tightened its artist-assignment guarantees.

Overall, Blush Studio is a capable choice for large bridal parties, with the
caveat that couples should get the named lead artist and the final price
explicitly confirmed in the contract.
